judge-court-of-appeals-16.note: Nonpartisan: the Secretary of State's files print every candidate's party as NP, which the Secretary's party table names Nonpartisan; each judgeship is a nonpartisan office under Minnesota Statutes, section 204B.06, subdivision 6.
